review_question: Among patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve replacement, does new permanent pacemaker implantation affect subsequent clinical outcomes compared with no new permanent pacemaker implantation?

population.description: Patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve replacement or implantation

intervention_or_exposure.description: New permanent pacemaker implantation after TAVR

comparator.description: No new permanent pacemaker implantation after TAVR

targets.comparison: New PPM after TAVR versus no new PPM after TAVR; exclude pre-existing PPM from both groups.
targets.population_or_subgroup: Source-defined TAVR cohort without pre-existing PPM.

timepoint_policy.rule: Use a source-reported post-TAVR cumulative all-cause-death comparison with at least 10 months of follow-up. Preserve the actual source timepoint and risk set. Do not substitute a hazard ratio for arm counts.

targets.effect_selection_rule: Retain one all-cause-death arm-count comparison per independent report. Prefer the directly tabulated study-specific long-term comparison. Keep alternative timepoints as non-selected candidates when the report exposes incompatible risk sets.

field_definitions.new_ppm_deaths: All-cause deaths in the new post-TAVR PPM group.
field_definitions.new_ppm_total: Participants in the new PPM group.
field_definitions.no_new_ppm_deaths: All-cause deaths in the no-new-PPM group.

extraction_notes: Do not use mortality plus hospitalization composite endpoints.
Do not replace raw death counts with adjusted hazard ratios.
The source corpus contains timepoint-selection ambiguity; preserve each source timepoint in the extraction record.

human_escalation_rules: A report gives several all-cause-death timepoints with changing risk sets.
A report includes pre-existing PPM in either comparison arm.
Only an adjusted hazard ratio is reported without recoverable arm counts.
